fact: Raxio Group's CTO says the CIV1 data centre in Abidjan, inaugurated September 2024, is fed by two independent (N+N) 15kV feeders sourced directly from the CIE substation, each able to carry 100% of the load.

Raxio CTO Rob Saunders says Raxio invests in medium-voltage lines direct from the substation to its facility in each market and always uses two independently sufficient power lines, plus diesel generators.
